ess.name: ESS
ess.title: Electronic Sales System
ess.description: ESS is a comprehensive system for managing electronic invoices and receipts. Create, review, and send documents to the Egyptian Tax Authority while tracking their status and managing sales operations—all in one integrated platform.
features: Unified management: products, customers, suppliers, branches, and POS devices in one place
Operational flexibility: access from any device with tailored user permissions and controls
Easier migration: bulk import products, customers, and data—no manual entry required
Greater multi-company management: run multiple companies from one account with independent profiles

ers.name: ERS
ers.title: POS E-Receipts
ers.description: Designed specifically for retail point-of-sale teams to issue e-receipts instantly and send them to the tax authority from one fast cashier screen. Manage branches and POS devices centrally, track receipt status in real time, and monitor daily sales performance from any device.
features: Instant receipt issuance purpose-built cashier interface designed for speed and accuracy
Flexible integration seamlessly import receipts from other sales systems
Centralized management complete control over POS devices, branches, and cashier permissions from one dashboard
Live monitoring cloud-based dashboard tracks receipt status (accepted, rejected, processing) and daily sales in real time

esa.name: ESA
esa.title: Electronic Signature Agent
esa.description: An advanced electronic signature application designed as a practical and modern alternative to ePass2003. Enables secure and easy use of e-signature and e-seal certificates across different platforms and electronic portals.
features: Comprehensive support for signing devices: works with various electronic signature devices (USB Tokens)
User-error protection: designed to reduce operational errors and usage mistakes, ensuring safer, more stable signing
Compatible with tax portal requirements: designed to meet Egyptian Tax Authority e-signature standards
